episode_event_salon_pasiosalon_date_ch02:
[Name:PlayerNickname ] spotted Bede
battling Team Break.
[EN:Gen Ref="255" M="He" F="She" ] decided to join and help Bede.
I don’t know what you’re up to...
but you’d better not hold me back!

Together, [Name:PlayerNickname ] and
Bede took down Team Break.

Not bad for an impromptu performance,
I suppose.
Although you weren’t nearly as good as me.
I may have told you this...

but I’ve been using that lot as a stepping
stone—to test my skills.
By myself, of course.
I’m skilled enough to battle them alone.

So there was never any need to enlist
anyone’s help.
(Ask about Opal.)
Wha—?! Why bring up that old gran?!
(Ask about Gloria and the others.)
Are you insinuating I rely on them?

I suppose there may have been a slight
change...
to how I interact with others.
Probably because of that old ha—
Ahem! Never mind. I’ve said too much.
I’ll be on my way. Excuse me.
Hm? You’d like to talk more?
You simply can’t leave me alone, can you.

Then...since you helped me, how about I
return the favor?

I’ll train you personally,
[Name:PlayerNickname ].
After Bede’s special training...
Tired already?

If you wish to win consistently, you mustn’t
show weakness.

You are too considerate of your opponent.
It creates openings.
Well...

I say that, but I suppose I’ve offered you
help every now and then.
Hm? Helping others isn’t a bad thing?
You’re wrong.

Think of it this way: What if you were down
on your luck...

but couldn’t get back on your feet on your
own? What would you do?

I once had my path ripped out from
under me.
I lost hope for a while...
But in the end, I found new light.
Even if others helped me up...
who I needed to believe in most was myself.

I’ve decided how I’ll live and what paths I’ll
follow. That won’t change.

I will not compromise or waver. I am
focused on my future.
Now, was that enough chin-wag?
It’s time I headed back.
(Say you’ll go back with him.)

No, thank you. If we headed back together,
we’d look chummy.

(Sadly ask if you’ll be heading back
alone.)
Spare me your disappointment.
I have my path, and you have yours.
Soon, with power only I can produce...

I will cover the world in the color of Bede.
You can look forward to that.
